{
  "findings": [
    {
      "id": "F-1",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-16",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "CH-16 requires dedicated PK visits V2.1 (Day 2), V2.2 (Day 6 ±1), V2.3 (Day 10 ±1), V7.1 (Day 72), V7.2 (Day 76), V7.3 (Day 80 ±1), and V8.1 (Day 90 ±2) with PK form collection, none of which are added to the casebook events. Additionally, the 480 h (Day 90 / V8.1) timepoint is missing from the PKTPT codelist."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-2",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-05",
      "change_id": "CH-14",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-05 and OP-06 add Anti-TJ301 antibody (ADA) items to the PK form, which is scheduled across V2–V9 and restricted in the protocol to the Mainland China PK subgroup (footnote e, p. 45). Per Table 1 and Figure 5 (pp. 45, 47), ADA samples must be collected for all patients at V2, V3, V4, V6, V8, and V9 (not at V5 or V7)."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-3",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-03",
      "change_id": "CH-13",
      "page": 44,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-03 and OP-04 add Diary Dispensing and Diary Review items to the PMAYO form, which is collected at V2–V8. According to Table 1 (p. 44) and Section 6.2 (pp. 49–50), Diary Dispensing is required at V1, V1.1, and V2–V7 (not V8), and Diary Review is required at V1.1 and V2–V8."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-4",
      "kind": "untraceable",
      "op_id": "OP-04",
      "change_id": "CH-13",
      "page": 50,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "OP-04 adds the 'Patient Diary Reviewed' item (DIARYREV) but cites only the quote 'Diary dispensing' instead of 'Diary review' on page 50."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-5",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-09",
      "change_id": "CH-12",
      "page": 94,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-09 adds an edit check requiring IMP infusion duration to be 'exactly 2 hours' (hours_between != 2), whereas the protocol rationale on page 94 explicitly removed the ±3 minute tolerance because 'for some sites, it may be difficult to control the dosing time within ±3 min.' Enforcing a strict zero-tolerance edit check contradicts the amendment's intent to relax dosing duration tolerance."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-6",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-10",
      "change_id": "CH-5",
      "page": 51,
      "severity": "high",
      "detail": "OP-10 checks that the 2 h (EOI) PK sample is taken exactly 2 hours after EXSTDTC (hours_between != 2) and scopes the rule only to V2 and V7. Per Section 6.2.5 (p. 51), 2 h (end of infusion) PK samples are also collected at the 2nd–5th doses (V3, V4, V5, V6) and have an acceptable time window of ±3 minutes (or ±10 minutes), not exact equality."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-7",
      "kind": "mismatch",
      "op_id": "OP-11",
      "change_id": "CH-4",
      "page": 45,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "OP-11 cites page 26 (randomisation stratification) without quoting any PK timepoints, and only restricts 48 h, 144 h, and 240 h to PK substudy participants across V2, V7, and V8. Per footnote e of Table 1 (p. 45) and Section 6.2.5 (p. 51), all PK blood sampling—not just those three timepoints—is for the Mainland China PK subgroup only."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-8",
      "kind": "uncertain",
      "op_id": "OP-08",
      "change_id": "CH-7",
      "page": 49,
      "severity": "medium",
      "detail": "The protocol is internally inconsistent regarding the acceptable window for historical/screening endoscopies: Inclusion Criterion 4 (p. 34) and Table 1 footnote c (p. 45) require Day -35 to Day -6, Table 1 footnote b (p. 45) states 'within 35 days before Randomisation is acceptable', and Section 6.2.2 (p. 49) still states 'Endoscopy conducted within 2 months before Randomisation is acceptable.' A reviewer must confirm whether Day -35 to Day -6 applies strictly to all endoscopies."
    },
    {
      "id": "F-9",
      "kind": "missing",
      "op_id": null,
      "change_id": "CH-21",
      "page": 87,
      "severity": "low",
      "detail": "CH-21 updated specific assay details for HIV, HBV, HCV, TB, EBV, and CMV screening tests in Appendix 2, while OP-07 only updated the TB form and left the VIRO form (HIV, HBV, HCV, EBV, CMV Test) unchanged."
    }
  ],
  "overall_uncertainty": "Because the current casebook omits several standard forms (such as Physical Examination and individual Inclusion/Exclusion criterion items), I could not verify whether CH-9 (adding Inclusion Criterion 8) or CH-15 (removing physical examinations at V3, V5, and V7) required form changes outside the provided build."
}
